title: stelis oblonga
intro: Stelis oblonga, commonly known as Orchid, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Orchidaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, with health benefits that include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, as well as potential anticancer and antioxidant activities. The therapeutic actions of Stelis oblonga include its ability to stimulate the immune system and exhibit anti-tumor and anti-bacterial properties, which can aid in the treatment of various diseases. The bioactive constituents of Stelis oblonga include alkaloids, flavonoids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
